summary:
The plan is a double cross: a north–south body crossed by three east–west bars, with two big planted courtyards and smaller courts between them. The wings are 12-storey flat-roofed blocks in beige smooth sandstone, with a grid of 3-block bays of recessed dark windows and about 1 in 6 lit. Every wing ends in a blank 13-storey squared tower, as in the photo.
In the middle, a stepped-up central block carries a floodlit penthouse and masts with red aircraft lights, and every roof is a lit slab deck behind a quartz coping line. The west front on Shifu Road has a quartz-columned canopy, the name, the city emblem and flagpoles, and the camera-facing south and east fronts get the most lit windows and floodlit tower panels. Double-cross civic block: 12-storey sandstone wings with piered dark-window grid, 13-storey blank towers, stepped central block with floodlit quartz crown and red-lit masts. West Shifu Rd portico with lit glass hall, emblem, flagpoles; planted courts with fountains.
Facades, roofs and lights are split by trade so S/E faces and roofs read at dusk.

rooms.name: Entrance hall
rooms.purpose: Lit ceremonial lobby behind the west glass wall; smooth_stone floor, sea_lantern ceiling every 4, reception desk of quartz, a few benches, city banner. Visible through glass only.

rooms.name: North spur lobby
rooms.purpose: Glazed lit pedestrian link, smooth_stone floor, sea_lantern ceiling, planters.

rooms.name: South spur lobby
rooms.purpose: Glazed lit pedestrian link mirroring the north spur; lit for the camera.

rooms.name: South podium lobby
rooms.purpose: Lit shop/lobby glazing storey under the south terrace, seen from the camera; smooth_stone floor, sea_lantern ceiling, a few counters.

rooms.name: North podium lobby
rooms.purpose: Lit ground storey of the north podium; same treatment.

rooms.name: East entry lobby
rooms.purpose: Small lit lobby behind T5 east glass with canopy.

parts.name: Massing and shell
parts.scope: All masses M1-M15, T1-T9 with plinth (polished_andesite y0..2), 2-deep skin, backing black_concrete, courtyards left open, all openings left air. Vocab: plinth.

parts.name: Roofs and terraces
parts.scope: Flat decks y62/67/15/10, parapets, quartz coping, penthouses (3 boxes), tower plant boxes, podium terraces, lanterns every 8. Vocab: roofDeck, penthouse, plantBox, planter.

parts.name: Facades
parts.scope: Office bay grid, piers, spandrels, string course y7, ground-storey glazing, tower faces with slots/joints/quoins, lit windows, spur pavilion glazing, podium and entry glazing. Vocab: officeBay, litWindow, stringCourse, groundBay, towerFace, quoin, spurPavilion, litEntry.

parts.name: Portico and west front
parts.scope: Slab ramp x0..1, 6 columns, canopy y13, fascia, underside lights, glass hall x19, 4 double doors, name banner, emblem disc, 6 flagpoles, apron paving and lamp posts. Vocab: column, canopyLight, lobbyGlass, doubleDoor, slabRamp, nameBand, emblemDisc, flagpole, lampPost.

parts.name: Courtyards and grounds
parts.scope: CN, CS lawns, cross paths, fountains, trees; small courts CNE, CSE, CNW, CSW; planters; lamp posts. Vocab: tree, fountain, planter, lampPost.

parts.name: Dusk lighting and crown
parts.scope: M7c crown walls with pearlescent band, M7 ochre light slot, floodlight courses on E/S tower faces, 4 masts with redstone_torch, tower torches, lobby floors and ceilings lit. Vocab: crownBand, floodCourse, mast.

recruit.why: Tile-clad walls, piers, plinth, quoins, string courses.
Window grid, lobby glass, doors, entries.
Dusk glow, crown floodlights, aircraft lights, no dark roofs.
